scope: FIRST independent visual rendering review ONLY of the eight authorized saved English screenshots: desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844, each with one whole-page image, one definition viewport, and two figure images.

bindingChecks.method: One read-only Node verification command checked the supplied report hash, its lesson/native-HTML/display-HTML/PNG/receipt/helper bindings, the existing text freeze and review, the reviewed English draft and flow, and the unchanged figure manifest/spec/SVG/render/review files. Repeated paths were deduplicated. Source geometry and SCI were not reviewed again.
bindingChecks.absolutePathsBytesAndHashes: The companion n1-pixel.freeze.json binds nonimage inputs; n1-image-ledger.json binds all eight images and their actual open order.

perImageObservations.observation: The main heading and single-line breadcrumb fit the centered text column. The spring demonstration, Figure 1/caption, pendulum prose and marked Earth footnote, Figure 2/caption, periodicity discussion, and ruled free/forced sections form an uninterrupted top-to-bottom flow. Visible lines, inline force symbols and captions do not collide or run beyond the column; the final paragraph has bottom clearance. The footnote marker and separate footnote paragraph are visible without an apparent collision.
perImageObservations.limitation: Whole-page supplied preview is an overview, not certification of every fine glyph or footnote glyph at native pixel scale.

perImageObservations.observation: The equal-interval periodic-motion definition is separated from the next paragraph. The examples, rule, bold run-in Free oscillations heading, system/internal/external definitions, released-system explanation and no-driver/damping paragraph have readable lines and regular spacing. The lower rule and beginning of Forced oscillations remain distinct. The screenshot begins and ends within scrolling prose; these viewport boundaries are not internal layout clipping.
perImageObservations.limitation: The legacy polarization filename is not a content claim: the visible viewport is the N1 periodic/free-oscillation section. It does not contain the Earth footnote.

perImageObservations.observation: Both spring panels, supports, bases, bobs and motion arrows are fully contained. F0 with its subscript and vector mark, G with its vector mark, and panel letters a/b are legible and separate from adjacent labels. Panel a shows the equilibrium bob and force-arrow axis; panel b visibly has the longer spring and lower bob, with separated up/down motion arrows. Dashed reference lines remain visible. No label, apparatus or panel edge is clipped.
perImageObservations.limitation: Visual display/state distinction only; no new exact-geometry measurement or original-source comparison.

perImageObservations.observation: Panel a has a complete vertical string, bob, support/base and clearly readable force labels. Panel b visibly retains one common pivot and solid left/dashed center/dashed right string states along the curved bob-position trajectory. The successive-position layout reads as a fixed-length pendulum; state bobs, two opposed motion arrows and panel letters are distinguishable. The rightmost bob, dashed trajectory, support and labels stay inside the image.
perImageObservations.limitation: Fixed-length appearance and display clarity only; approved exact geometry is reused without recalculation or source-pixel replay.

perImageObservations.observation: The main heading fits on one line; the breadcrumb wraps to two lines with a clear gap before prose. Paragraphs and inline force expressions wrap inside the 358-pixel content column without visible overlap or right-edge loss. Both figure/caption pairs remain between the intended surrounding prose. The pendulum footnote marker and marked Earth paragraph are visible and separated. Rules, bold run-in free/forced headings, definitions and the final examples retain orderly flow and bottom clearance.
perImageObservations.limitation: The tall supplied full-page preview is not all-fine-glyph certification. Footnote layout is inspected here only at the supplied overview scale; no extra viewport or crop was authorized.

perImageObservations.observation: The preceding examples, rule, bold run-in Free oscillations heading, system/internal/external definitions and released-system explanation are readable at the mobile viewport. The heading/body transition and narrow-column line wraps do not overlap. All visible line ends remain inside the margins, including the final mass-on-a-spring example. The top starts with the tail of a preceding paragraph as expected for a scrolled viewport.
perImageObservations.limitation: This saved viewport does not show the Earth footnote or all of the forced-oscillation section; those regions receive overview-only layout assessment from image 5.

perImageObservations.observation: The two spring states still fit side by side at the actual 358-pixel media width. F0/subscript/vector mark, G/vector mark and a/b are distinguishable. Supports, spring coils, both bobs, dashed equilibrium references and separate motion arrows remain visible. The lower bob and longer spring in b are easy to distinguish from a; no edge clipping or label collision is visible.
perImageObservations.limitation: Judgment is for this saved actual-width rendering, not an enlarged source canvas or untested viewport.

perImageObservations.observation: The equilibrium panel and pendulum-state panel are legible at 358 pixels. F0/G and a/b do not collide with the apparatus. Panel b preserves the common-pivot, fixed-length appearance; solid and dashed strings, all three bob positions, curved trajectory and opposing arrows remain distinguishable. The rightmost bob has clearance from the image edge and nothing is visibly clipped.
perImageObservations.limitation: Saved-pixel clarity and fixed-length state layout only, not a new geometric or scientific approval.
